notes: Account overview: DiffHound builds a GitHub-style PR review assistant for mid-sized engineering teams; goal is to auto-generate review comments, summarize diffs, and surface high-confidence suggestions into CI checks.
Primary ask: low-latency streaming for inline review comments + batch reranking for top suggestions before posting to PRs.
Latency targets (from PO): streaming token latency <= 50ms; end-to-end comment gen for small diffs < 1s; 95th pctp for heavy diffs < 2s.
Throughput: target 200 concurrent PR streams across teams; reranker must score up to ~3k candidate comments/minute during large CI runs.
Security: code cannot leave customer's VPC for raw repo contents, needs KMS integration, audit logs for every inference call, SSO (SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning.

Model/versioning: must support pinning to a specific model build/sha and controlled rollouts (canary + auto-fallback to pinned fallback model). Team asked specifically for "code-optimized-7B-quantized" and a deterministic reranker version.
Caching/optimization asks: prefix/KV caching for repeated review contexts, reuse tokenized diffs, and recommended batching policy for low-cost throughput during CI windows.
Quote from CTO (10/20 intro): "We need the assistant to be auditable and predictable — if it suggests a change, we must prove which model + version made that suggestion."
Preferences: prefer Redwood API hosted for speed of iteration but must support Dedicated/VPC or on-prem for production due to IP/residency requirements.
Pricing sensitivity: willing to pay premium for predictable latency SLA and private deployment; wants Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token spend for nightly CI runs.
Legal/security notes: requested data residency clause (EU customers later), retention controls to delete repo snapshots after 30 days, require SOC2 attestation from Redwood before procurement.
Attachments shared: pricing deck (drive link), security questionnaire v1 (drive link), sample diff set for initial eval (s3 stub provided in POC email).
